paragraphs: Talitrix sells wrist-worn monitoring hardware and supervision software presented as one system spanning custody and community supervision. Heart rate sensors are listed as part of the band. Straps for the wrist and the ankle are replaceable.

The platform is called Talitrix ONE and is organized around roles in the justice lifecycle. Pages for agencies name sheriffs, county leadership, pretrial and probation administration, courts, judges, and district attorneys. Agency features listed include court-admissible documentation and a secure chain of custody for evidentiary data. A Talitrix Score is offered for every case, and a Supervisor T-App is offered for field access.

A second page addresses participants, who wear the wrist-worn All-In-One Band. The participant app is described as a compliance support tool for understanding obligations. Alerts are described as surfacing court dates and condition gaps before a violation is recorded.

quote.text: One connected system for Inside and Outside the Walls monitoring.
